house.description: Description of wild rice as state grain amended.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to State Government Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to state government; amending description of wild rice as state grain; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 1.148.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 1.148, is amended to read:

1.148 STATE GRAIN.

Subdivision 1.
Wild rice.
Zizania aquatica[+ or zizania palustris+], commonly known as wild rice[+, psíŋ,+] or [-manomin-][+ manoomin+], is the official state grain of the state of Minnesota.[+ It is the policy of this state to recognize the inherent right of uncultivated wild rice to exist and thrive in Minnesota. +]

Subd. 2.
Photograph.
A photograph of zizania aquatica[+ or zizania palustris+], commonly known as wild rice[+, psíŋ,+] or [-manomin-][+ manoomin+], may be displayed in the Office of the Secretary of State.
